title: two independent contact-angle wall conditions (walberla two-independent-impls做法)

reference.law: Young: sigma_lg*cos(theta) = sigma_sg - sigma_sl.  In the diffuse-interface (Allen-Cahn / Cahn-Hilliard) model the same law is imposed as (i) a wall VALUE psi_w with cos(theta)=(3 psi_w - psi_w^3)/2, (ii) a wall FLUX kappa*d_n psi = (3/4) sigma cos(theta)(1-psi^2), (iii) a GEOMETRIC ghost psi_g = psi_0 + cot(theta)|d_t psi|.  The prescribed theta is the continuum Young reference theta_ref.
source: de Gennes, Rev. Mod. Phys. 57 (1985) 827 (Young's law / wall free energy)
Jacqmin, J. Comput. Phys. 155 (1999) 96 (wetting boundary condition for diffuse interfaces)
Briant, Wagner & Yeomans, Phys. Rev. E 69 (2004) 031602 (order-parameter wetting in LBM)
walberla free-surface ContactAngle.h / OSS inventory row 281 (two independent contact-angle implementations)

estimators.theta_cap_deg: conserved-content Laplace-cap area inversion (implementation-blind, uses content + apex)
estimators.theta_circle_deg: algebraic least-squares circle fit of the mid-level contour (implementation-blind, global shape)
estimators.theta_normal_deg: contact-line interface-normal direction from field gradients at the two mid-level crossings of the two wall-adjacent rows (implementation-blind, local derivative; benchmark-side, shares no code with the module estimators)

gates.G2_definition: |theta_med - theta_ref|/theta_ref*100 with theta_med = median of the finite estimators; must be < 15% (owner accuracy standard)
gates.G3_definition: per angle, (max(theta_med) - min(theta_med))/theta_ref*100 across arms; must be < 15%
gates.G4_definition: max(estimator) - min(estimator) per row (diagnostic gate: predeclared at 10 deg; a violation is reported, not silently widened)
gates.G6_neutral_limit_degeneracy: at theta=90 deg the neumann_flux and geometric_ghost arms reduce to the same Neumann ghost -> max|psi_a - psi_b| < 1e-9 (consistency check of the two implementations in their common limit)
gates.G7_definition: production solver CAC2D (wall_phi_policy='wall_order', psi_w = psi_wall_from_angle(theta)) measured angle vs theta_ref, < 15% (optional --solver arm; needs the LBE solve)

predeclared_note: G2/G3 use the owner accuracy standard 15%; G4 was fixed at 10 deg before the graded sweep was inspected and is kept at 10 deg even though round-2/3 review measured an 11.2 deg gap for the dirichlet arm at 90 deg (reported as an open item, see docs/XVAL-LBM-TWO-INDEPENDENT-CONTACT-ANGLE-IMPLS.md section 5).
